error_not_found_description: The page you are looking for does not exist.
error_generic_description: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.
common_invalid_input: Please check your input and try again.
common_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
common_rate_limited_generic: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
reauth_code_hint: Also enter the current code from your authenticator app.
reauth_missing_code: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
reauth_invalid_code: The authentication code is not valid.
login_description: Sign in to manage your content.
login_invalid_input: Enter a valid email address and your password.
login_invalid_credentials: The email address or password is incorrect.
login_locked: Too many failed attempts. Signing in to this account is paused for 15 minutes.
login_two_factor_description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login_two_factor_backup_description: Enter one of your backup codes. Each code works only once.
login_two_factor_expired: This sign-in attempt has expired. Please sign in again.
login_two_factor_locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
panel_welcome_description: Your content tools will appear here. For now you can manage the security of your account.
password_description: Use at least 12 characters. Common passwords are not accepted.
password_forced_notice: Choose a new password before you continue.
password_changed: Your password has been changed and your other sessions were signed out.
password_too_short: The new password must be at least 12 characters long.
password_too_long: The new password must be at most 128 characters long.
password_too_common: This password is too common. Choose one that is harder to guess.
password_reused: The new password must be different from the current one.
password_mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
two_factor_description: Protect your account with a one-time code from an authenticator app in addition to your password.
two_factor_required_notice: Your role requires two-factor authentication. Set it up to continue.
two_factor_start_description: Enter your password to start the setup.
two_factor_pending_description: The setup is in progress. Enter a code from your authenticator app to finish it, or start over.
two_factor_scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the setup key manually.
two_factor_qr_label: QR code for your authenticator app
two_factor_backup_codes_save: Save these codes in a safe place. Each code can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator app. They will not be shown again.
two_factor_confirm_description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to finish the setup.
two_factor_not_started: The setup was not started or has been replaced. Please start again.
two_factor_regenerate_description: Create a new set of backup codes. The old codes stop working.
two_factor_disable_description: Your other sessions will be signed out.
sessions_description: Devices that are currently signed in to your account.
sessions_revoked_others: All other sessions were signed out.
error_forbidden_description: You do not have permission to open this page.
link_invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask an administrator for a new one.
users_description: Invite people and manage their access.
users_invite_description: The new user chooses their own password through a one-time link.
users_invite_created: Invitation created for {name}. Send them this one-time link. It expires in 72 hours.
users_email_taken: A user with this email address already exists.
user_deactivate_description: The user can no longer sign in and all of their sessions end immediately. Their posts stay as they are.
user_reactivate_description: The user can sign in again.
user_role_description: Changing the role signs the user out everywhere. Confirm with your password.
user_publish_description: Authors who may publish directly skip the approval queue.
user_reset_description: Create a one-time link that lets the user choose a new password. It expires in 30 minutes and replaces older links.
user_reset_created: Send this one-time link to the user. It expires in 30 minutes.
user_invite_description: Create a new one-time invitation link. It expires in 72 hours and replaces older links.
user_invite_created: Send this one-time link to the user. It expires in 72 hours.
user_not_applicable: This action is not available for this user.
invite_completed: Your account is ready. You can now sign in.
reset_completed: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new password.
audit_description: Security-relevant events. Entries cannot be changed or removed.
profile_description: Your name and bio appear on your published posts. Language and theme apply to the panel.
profile_bio_hint: A short introduction shown with your posts.
languages_description: Languages that posts can be written in. The default language is chosen in the system settings.
languages_delete_confirm: Delete this language permanently? Category names in this language are removed as well. This cannot be undone.
languages_add_description: Use a BCP 47 code such as de, pt-BR or zh-Hans. The names are suggested when you leave them empty.
languages_error_invalid_code: Enter a valid BCP 47 language code.
languages_error_default: The default language cannot be disabled or deleted.
languages_error_in_use: Posts use this language, so it can only be disabled.
categories_description: Each category has a name and a URL slug per language. A post can belong to one category.
categories_create_description: A name in the default language is required. Leave a slug empty to create it from the name.
categories_slug_hint: Slugs use lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Names without Latin letters get a short random slug.
categories_delete_description: No post uses this category, so it can be deleted permanently.
categories_error_missing_default: Enter a name in the default language.
categories_error_invalid_slug: The slug for {code} must contain letters or digits.
categories_error_slug_taken: Another category already uses this slug in {code}.
categories_error_in_use: Posts use this category, so it cannot be deleted.
settings_description: Settings that apply to the whole installation. Only the founder can change them.
settings_public_site_hint: When off, Servitor runs headless: the public pages return 404 and content is only available through the API.
settings_require_two_factor: Require two-factor authentication for the founder and admins
settings_require_two_factor_hint: Affected users without two-factor authentication must set it up right after signing in.
settings_api_rate_limit: Default API rate limit (requests per minute)
settings_error_language: Choose an enabled language as the default.
